overview: You read the Rose's afternoon, Harry the Fifth at two, and you did not go. Your own house had an afternoon of its own.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the bill and stayed in his own yard.

parties.name: Philip Henslowe
parties.context: Not in the yard. His afternoon was on the board, and that was all.
